# Invisible navigation ghost (2026-02-05 18:30Z)

_**User**_

when the user starts navigation the route FROM the selected device towards the user is shown. Right now there also is a projected ghost shown at the assumed position of the device. 

Unfortunately in the default mode the route is shown in green (ghost route portion) and blue (the remaining route) correctly but the ghost itself is invisible/not rendered.

The ghost should only be hidden when the navigation route has been reversed by the user by pressing the reverse-button at the top
